name: Buckwheat wine
summary: Wine made from buckwheat, poured with the buckwheat foods and at the Đồng Văn festival. It is a different drink from the corn wine.
origin: The Hà Giang plateau, and the Đồng Văn festival.
howToEat: Drink it with the buckwheat foods, or at the festival in November.
where: On the plateau, and at the Đồng Văn festival.
seoTitle: Buckwheat wine on the Ha Giang plateau
seoDescription: Buckwheat wine is a plateau drink poured at the Đồng Văn festival, a different drink from the corn wine.
